race.comment: GLOBAL ECLIPSE (4) had some excuses when failing to fire as a short-priced favourite at Eagle Farm a month ago, and will drop in trip from 1820m to 1400m. He has the pole position, and if he can hold his spot early on, then he is more than capable of making an immediate return to the top 3 placings. Follow your money. KING JAKKAL (9) has been bought of NZ after last racing in G3 company at Ellerslie in April. He has trialled up nicely, and though he will want more ground than this, he can still sprint sharply fresh. Follow the markets. COL BURN (2) bolted in on a heavy track here 18 days ago, and he only needs luck from a wide draw to be a top 4 chance in this. THE BEAR (6) will be peaking third up, and an extra 200m here is the key. Expect this gelding to be a top 4 threat this time.
